name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Management & Customer Retention | Renewals, Upsells, Phone-Based Account Care & Salesforce
summary: Account manager who keeps small business customers and grows what they buy. Retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye, hit 120% of sales targets at Wix, and has worked high-volume phone books (up to 150 calls a day at Fivestars). Steps in early when an account shows risk, documents every call and proposal in Salesforce, and looks for the next service a customer actually needs.
